title: Topic 18
japanese_text: 入社以来、<u>使命感</u>に燃えて仕事に打ち込んできたが、上司にはまだ<u>青い</u>と言われ、なかなかやりたい仕事を割り当ててもらえない。私のことをインターン<u>上がり</u>のコネ採用だと<u>陰口</u>を言う人もいる。
english_translation: Since I joined the company, I've been working hard with a sense of mission, but my boss says I'm still green and aren't assigning me the kind of work I want to do. People talk behind my back about me, calling me an ex-intern hired for my connections.
